newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY SLIPS FROM HIGHS, C.BANK UPS DRAINAGE RATES.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY SLIPS FROM HIGHS, C.BANK UPS DRAINAGE RATES.

text.p: The Polish zloty lost nearly half a point against its currency basket on Tuesday as banks rebuild currency positions after shortening them on Monday when the zloty soared to four week highs, dealers said.
They said that foreign currency speculators gave the zloty a late boost after the local unit slumped to intraday lows nearly one percent weaker than the parity rate.

"Local banks bought currencies very strongly today and depressed the zloty to around -0.95 percent before foreign interest lifted the zloty in late trade," said Piotr Czyzewski, forex dealer at ING Bank in Warsaw.
The zloty closed 0.78/0.90 percent weaker than the parity rate against Monday's close at -0.26/-0.31 percent.
It closed at 3.4839/79 to the dollar, against 3.4685/00 on Monday and at 1.8770/91 to the mark, against 1.8690/00.
Dealers said foreign investors bought the zloty because it now had both a National Bank of Poland-guarded ceiling and a floor after Monday's currency-buying intervention.
"Now is a good time for foreigners to get into the zloty because the NBP is guarding the rate on both sides, which gives them some security," said foreign bank dealer in Warsaw.
On Monday the central bank bought dollars when the zloty was a fraction stronger than parity after last selling dollars when the zloty was around -1.5 percent in late July.
The NBP on Tuesday increased the benchmark 14-day reverse repo maximum rate to 23.55 pct from the previous 23.00 percent in its first drainage since it increased official rates.
It also raised the seven day rate to 23.45 from 22.89 and the average yield on its 91-day bills to 23.45 pct from 23.00.
"Because this was the first drainage after the (official) rate rise players tested what new rate levels which the NBP wants to accept," Piotr Schmidt, dealer at Pekao SA.
One-day rates jumped after the reverse repo with overnight deposits closing at 23.00/23.25 percent against 22.84/22.99 at opening. Tomorrow/next were at 23.10/23.30 against 22.90/23.00.
